ledger: Kitchen layout | Cabinets right, stove left, leading to a hallway | Replaced by hallway | Completely changes upon return
Hallway layout | Straight path to front door, bedroom entrance on right | Becomes the kitchen | Hallway vanishes, replaced by kitchen
Bedroom doorway | Connects to the hallway | Connects directly to the kitchen | Spatial connectivity changes drastically
Wall artwork (blue flower) | On the wall separating kitchen and hallway | On the left side of the bedroom doorway | Teleports and changes context

findings.description: When the woman turns around to exit the bedroom, the hallway she originally walked through has disappeared. The bedroom doorway now opens directly into the kitchen, which has also been repositioned. The spatial relationship between the rooms is completely altered.
The framed picture of the blue flower, initially seen on the wall between the kitchen and the hallway, is now located on the wall to the left of the bedroom doorway as she exits.
